title: 句重音与节奏
goal: 判断一句话中重读的词；根据语境判断对比重音的位置。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 口语

points.label: 判断一句话中重读的词
根据语境判断对比重音的位置

body.p: 句重音决定句中哪些词读得更突出。没有对比的陈述句里，名词、主要动词、形容词和副词通常重读。冠词、介词、代词和助动词通常弱读。具体读法还要看上下文。

body.box: The GUIDE will CHECK the NEW ROUTE.

body.p: 本课用大写标出重读的词，录音不一定这样读。带录音的题只用来给出句子。重音的位置按题干写明的语境判断。

cards.title: 实义词与功能词
rows: 名词
名词带出人和物的信息，通常重读。
The TRAIN crossed the BRIDGE.
主要动词
表达动作或状态，通常比助动词突出。
The assistant will CHECK the LIST.
形容词
提供新的性质或区别时通常重读。
The LARGE container is EMPTY.
副词
表示新的程度、方式或时间信息时可重读。
The gate closed SLOWLY.
冠词与介词
没有对比时读得弱，但不能省。
The KEY is in the DRAWER.
代词与助动词
指已知对象的代词和普通助动词通常读得弱。
She has FINISHED the DRAWING.
否定与对比
表示否定或被纠正的功能词也可以重读。
The notes are FOR the tutor, not FROM the tutor.
已知信息
已经说过的实义词读得弱，新信息重读。
What arrived? → A PARCEL arrived.

cards.title: 节奏与信息焦点
rows: 重音间隔
重音之间的间隔大致相近，但不是严格等长。
CATS CHASE MICE. / The CATS will CHASE the MICE.
非重读音节
两个重音之间的功能词读得短，但仍要说清。
The CATS could have CHASED the MICE.
语速与边界
意群边界处可以放慢，不必把各段压成一样长。
After the long rehearsal, / the players RESTED.
主语对比
纠正动作执行者时突出主语。
MAYA sent the sketch.（不是 Leo）
动作对比
纠正所做动作时突出动词。
Maya SENT the sketch.（不是 kept）
对象对比
纠正动作对象时突出宾语。
Maya sent the SKETCH.（不是 invoice）
新信息
重读回答问句的那个词，不一定是句末的词。
Who sent the sketch? → MAYA sent the sketch.
功能词对比
纠正方向或关系时，功能词可以成为焦点。
The parcel is FROM Maya, not FOR Maya.

body.box:
Context: Leo says the guide borrowed the camera. The guide explains that she bought it.
The guide bought the camera.
Which word should carry the corrective focus?
1. guide
2. the
3. bought
4. camera

body.p: 被纠正的是动作：borrowed 换成 bought。人物和物品都没变。所以 bought 是对比焦点，答案是第三项。

body.box: The GUIDE bought the camera. / The guide BOUGHT the camera. / The guide bought the CAMERA.

body.p: 三句分别突出买的人、买这个动作和买的东西。最突出的那个词，就是这句话要区分的信息。

lines.text: The porter will move the heavy crate.

items.stem: In a neutral reading, which set contains the main content words?
items.why: porter、move、heavy、crate 分别是人物、动作、性质和对象。will 和 the 是功能词，第二项把 will 当成了实义词。

lines.text: The editor has corrected the final paragraph.

items.stem: In a neutral reading, which set contains the main content words?
items.why: editor、corrected、final、paragraph 是本句的实义词。has 是助动词，没有对比时读得弱。

lines.text: The courier can deliver the fragile package.

items.stem: In a neutral reading, which set contains the main content words?
items.why: courier、deliver、fragile、package 是实义词。普通肯定句中的 can 读得弱。

lines.text: The dancer is wearing the silver costume.

items.stem: In a neutral reading, which set contains the main content words?
items.why: dancer、wearing、silver、costume 是实义词，is 是助动词。

groups.text: The wrong name was given: Leo prepared the slides. Correction: Nora prepared the slides.

items.why: Leo 换成了 Nora，被纠正的是做事的人，所以突出 Nora。

groups.text: The question is: What did the mechanic replace? Answer: The mechanic replaced the belt.

items.stem: Which word supplies the requested new information?
items.why: 问句已经给出人物和动作，belt 补出未知对象。

groups.text: The ticket is for Friday, not from Friday.

items.stem: Which word is contrasted with from?
items.why: for 和 from 表示的关系不同，所以功能词 for 重读。

groups.text: The donor lent the instrument rather than sold it. Target sentence: The donor lent the instrument.

items.stem: Which word should receive the corrective focus?
items.why: lent 与 sold 对比，需突出动作 lent。

lines.text: The researcher will compare the final estimates.

items.stem: Without contrast, which set identifies the content words?
items.why: researcher、compare、final、estimates 是实义词。will 和 the 读得弱，但不能省。第四项多了助动词 will。

lines.text: The plumber has replaced the damaged valve.

items.stem: Without contrast, which set identifies the content words?
items.why: plumber、replaced、damaged、valve 分别是人物、动作、性质和对象，是本句的主要信息。

lines.text: The drummer can adjust the loose pedal.

items.stem: Without contrast, which set identifies the content words?
items.why: drummer、adjust、loose、pedal 是实义词。题干说明没有对比，can 读得弱，第二项多了 can。

lines.text: The gardener is moving the empty planter.

items.stem: Without contrast, which set identifies the content words?
items.why: gardener、moving、empty、planter 是实义词，is 是助动词。

groups.text: Claim: Ada designed the poster. Correction: Milo designed the poster.

items.stem: Which word should be most prominent in the correction?
items.why: Ada 被纠正为 Milo。designed 和 poster 两句都有，不是新信息。

groups.text: Question: What did the archivist scan? Answer: The archivist scanned the diary.

items.stem: Which word carries the requested new information?
items.why: What did … scan 问扫描对象，diary 提供新信息。

groups.text: The package is from the engraver, not for the engraver.

items.stem: Which word should contrast with for?
items.why: from 和 for 分别表示来源和接收的人。这里 from 虽然是介词，也要重读。

groups.text: Claim: The tutor copied the diagram. Correction: The tutor drew the diagram.

items.stem: Which word is the corrective focus?
items.why: copied 被纠正为 drew，人物和对象没变，所以突出 drew。
